lesson.subject: general-knowledge
lesson.title: Our Community and Helpers
lesson.summary: Meet the people who help us at school and in the community and learn how to welcome others.
learning_objectives: Name community helpers and their roles
Say how to make someone feel welcome

standards.text: Recognise the different people in our community and what they do; learn how to be a good friend and include others

success_criteria: I can name helpers and say what they do
I can welcome a new child
I can thank a helper kindly
lesson.real_life: The lollipop person in the UK and the school guard in Pakistan, mosque volunteers, and Edhi ambulance drivers.

warm_up.prompt: Who helps us cross the road at school?

blocks.markdown: Today's big question: who helps us, and how can we help them?
blocks.say: Today we meet the people who help us. They keep our community running.

blocks.alt: A white striped pedestrian crossing painted on a dark road with yellow lines beside it
blocks.caption: A pedestrian crossing. A crossing patrol person helps children cross here.
blocks.credit: Photo by Benjamin Huggett on Unsplash
blocks.say: A crossing helps children cross the road safely. Someone stops the cars for us.

blocks.markdown: A **community** is a group of people who live or work together.
blocks.say: A community is a group of people who live or work together.

blocks.markdown: A **role** is the part someone plays in a group.
blocks.say: Our school is a community. Teachers, cooks and caretakers all have a role.

scenes.caption: Teachers.
scenes.say: Teachers help us learn. They plan lessons and listen to us.

scenes.caption: Cook and caretaker.
scenes.say: The cook makes lunch. The caretaker keeps the building clean and safe.

scenes.caption: Safety.
scenes.say: In the UK a lollipop person helps us cross. In Pakistan the school guard keeps the gate safe.

question.explanation: A community is a group of people who share a place.

options.text: A group of people who live or work together

blocks.text: Stop 2: Things we need to feel safe

blocks.markdown: Everyone has a role in keeping us safe.
blocks.say: We all need to feel safe at school. Safe places let us learn.

scenes.caption: Listening.
scenes.say: We need kind people who listen to us.

scenes.caption: Rules.
scenes.say: We need clear rules, like walking in the corridor.

scenes.caption: A safe place.
scenes.say: We need a safe place to go when we feel worried.

question.prompt: Everyone at school has a role.
question.explanation: Everyone has a part to play.

blocks.title: Sam's new classmate
blocks.transcript: Sam walks to school. A crossing patrol person helps him. He passes the baker, who gets up early. At school, a new classmate looks shy. Sam says hello and asks her name. He invites her to sit and play. The cook makes lunch for everyone. Sam makes a thank-you card for the cook. Everyone helps. That is what a community is.
blocks.caption: Sam meets a new classmate and thanks the people who help his school each morning.

points: A community is a group of people
We all need to feel safe
blocks.say: Let us remember. A school is a community. Everyone helps in their own way.

blocks.markdown: A **volunteer** helps others without being paid.
blocks.say: Many people work in our community. Some are paid, and some are volunteers.

blocks.caption: Fresh bread on bakery racks. Bakers get up very early to bake it.
blocks.credit: Photo by Maite Paternain on Unsplash
blocks.say: A baker bakes bread every day. This is a paid job.

scenes.caption: Doctor and driver.
scenes.say: A doctor helps us when we are ill. A bus driver gets us to school.

scenes.caption: Road and farm.
scenes.say: A road mender fixes roads. A farmer grows our food.

scenes.caption: Volunteers.
scenes.say: Volunteers help for free. Many help at the mosque or with Edhi ambulances.

options.text: Someone who helps without being paid

blocks.markdown: Caring for family is important work.
blocks.say: Many people care for others at home. This work is not paid, but it matters.

scenes.caption: Parents.
scenes.say: Parents cook, clean and care for children.

scenes.caption: Children.
scenes.say: Many children help too. They tidy, share and say kind words.

scenes.caption: Grandparents.
scenes.say: Looking after grandparents is also a way of caring.

blocks.text: Stop 1: Say hello in many ways

blocks.markdown: To **welcome** someone is to greet them kindly.
blocks.say: A new child may feel shy. A warm welcome can make a big difference.

scenes.caption: Hello.
scenes.say: Smile and wave. Say hello or Assalamu alaikum.

scenes.caption: Many ways.
scenes.say: In Swahili, say Jambo. In Urdu, say Assalamu alaikum.

scenes.caption: Names.
scenes.say: Ask their name. Tell them yours.

question.explanation: To welcome is to greet kindly.

blocks.title: Welcome steps
blocks.goal: Watch the order, then copy it. It gets longer each time!
blocks.say: Play the memory game. It helps us think about who is new.

scenes.caption: Sit together.
scenes.say: Invite them to sit with you.

scenes.caption: Play.
scenes.say: Invite them to play. Show them where things are.

scenes.caption: Stronger.
scenes.say: Everyone is different. Differences make our community stronger.

question.prompt: Differences can make a community stronger.

blocks.say: Let us remember. Welcome new people kindly. Include everyone.
